desc: Read the input string S from stdin.
Construct the string T = reverse(S) + '#' + S.
Compute the KMP prefix function (pi array) for T.
The value pi[-1] gives the length of the longest palindromic suffix of S.
Extract the non-palindromic prefix part: S[0 : n - pi[-1]].
Reverse this part and append it to S, then print the result.
